From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>

Subject: RE: Post-call recap & next steps 	6 unit economics (FintechX)

Asha 	6 thanks for the numbers, these are helpful. I ran a quick back-of-envelope to give you something concrete (assumes typical compression/quantization on model weights for Dedicated):

Assumptions we used:
- Avg tokens / call: 400
- Calls / MAU / day: 2.5
- MAU: 10,000
- Days / month: 30
- Monthly tokens = 10,000 * 2.5 * 400 * 30 = 300,000,000 tokens/month

Pricing scenarios (examples):
1) Hosted list pricing (example): $6.00 per 1M tokens => monthly inference cost = (300M / 1M) * $6 = $1,800
2) Volume-discount hosted (pilot pricing band): $4.00 per 1M tokens => $1,200 / month
3) Dedicated reserved (committed) estimate: $2.50 per 1M tokens (includes infra + support) => $750 / month

Compute cost / MAU / month:
- Using $4 / 1M tokens (pilot band) => monthly inference cost = $1,200 => cost / MAU = $1,200 / 10,000 = $0.12 per MAU / month.
- Using $2.5 / 1M (dedicated) => cost / MAU = $0.075 / MAU / month.

If you price the feature at $6 / MAU / month: gross margin contributions (inference-only)
- At $4 / 1M: margin per MAU = $6 - $0.12 = $5.88 => margin % ~98% (inference is tiny part of cost)
- At $2.5 / 1M: margin per MAU = $6 - $0.075 = $5.925 => margin % ~98.7%

CAC payback example:
- If CAC = $120 (you acquire a user for $120),  price = $6/month => payback = 120 / 6 = 20 months.
- If LTV / churn implies 36 months avg life, payback is acceptable; if your target payback is <= 12 months, you'd need either higher price or lower CAC.

$/1M tokens target: based on common thresholds we recommend banding:
- Pilot (<500M/mo): $3.5- $5 per 1M tokens (hosted tiers)
- Committed 6-12 month: $1.8- $2.8 per 1M tokens (dedicated reserved)

Notes on other unit costs: network egress, logging retention, and eval pipelines can add non-trivial overhead 	6 estimate an additional $0.01- $0.03 / MAU / month depending on retention policies.

Happy to formalize this in the worksheet and run a few sensitivity scenarios (CAC ±30%, tokens per call ±30%).

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

Thanks Asha 	6 and thanks Rishi for the clear breakdown. A couple pragmatic asks to get us to a pricing proposal: 

1) Asha/Ben 	6 can you confirm whether pilot is expected to be mostly read-only completions (lower token/tail risk) vs heavy context windows (longer prompts)? This changes our recommendations for model family and effective tokens.
2) If pilot budget is $12k- $18k / month, at the $4 / 1M pilot band that buys ~3,000-4,500M tokens 	6 more than enough for the 300M/month you estimated. This means we can propose a staged pricing:
   - Pilot (month 0-3): Hosted pilot rate $4.00 / 1M tokens, monthly commit optional
   - Ramp (month 4-6): Vol discount to $3.00 / 1M tokens if monthly avg > 500M tokens
   - Committed (6+ months): Dedicated pricing target $1.8- $2.5 / 1M tokens depending on commitment length and SLA requirements

3) For the deck I will prepare a short slide showing: $/MAU at each band, CAC payback sensitivity table (CAC $80- $160), and margin waterfall including inferred infra and ops overhead.

Next steps:
- Asha: share any precise daily MAU and call-type split (read completions vs contextual) 	6 I'll update the sheet and run both hosted + dedicated scenarios.
- Rishi/Vivek: prepare a Dedicated capacity sketch and rough lead time for provisioning (if they prefer to go that route).
- I'll draft a 3-month pilot commercial that fits the $12k- $18k budget and include a path to committed pricing.

Can we target Tues 17 Mar for a 30-min pricing review?

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
